purpose: Non-downloaded, manually curated external assets for ORA Space and HOMELESS. Each source is an option, not content already installed or permission for unrestricted redistribution.
media_policy: Pin asset file, license, source version and SHA-256 before copying into shipped packages; prefer CC0 for redistribution. Third-party licenses require separate compliance review.
